title: We hope wiser heads will prevail: Punjab & Haryana HC on lawyers’ strike over Legal Aid Defence Counsel System
description: Amid an indefinite strike by various Bar bodies in Punjab against Legal Aid Defence Counsel System (LADCS), the Punjab and Haryana High Court on Monday remarked that “wiser heads” should prevail in the matter [Arvind Seth v State of Punjab and Others].A Division Bench of Acting Chief Justice Ashwani Kumar Mishra and Justice Rohit Kapoor made the comment while dealing with a petition raising concern over the ongoing protest of lawyers and denial of access to justice to litigants in Punjab.“We hop
